text.text: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

wikipediaBodyRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, L–Z · Michael
wikipediaBodyRead.locator: Michael section, lines 532–540, especially line 537: describes a Manassite and one of David’s mighty warriors in Ziklag; the page footnote mistakenly cites 1 Chronicles 2:20, so it is a related source and not used to assert precise identity.
